recognize_zh: 這是免疫組化染色：許多中至大型細胞呈棕色細胞膜陽性，散布在大量陰性小淋巴球之間；圖上未標示抗體，需對照 CD20／CD3 等染色判讀 T 細胞／組織球豐富型大 B 細胞淋巴瘤中大細胞與背景細胞的免疫表型。
features: Immunohistochemical stain with crisp brown membranous (ring-like) staining
Positive cells are numerous, dispersed singly and in small groups, and are intermediate to large with pale nuclei
Background of many negative small round lymphoid nuclei counterstained blue
No sheets of positive large cells
Specific antibody not indicated in the image
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a lymph node section shows membranous staining of numerous dispersed intermediate-to-large cells, set against a background of negative small lymphocytes. The positive cells are distributed singly and in small loose groups without forming sheets. Because the antibody is not labeled, the precise interpretation is limited: in T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma, CD20 or PAX5 would highlight the scattered large neoplastic B cells, whereas CD3 would highlight the predominant background T cells. Findings should be interpreted together with the H&E and the full immunohistochemical panel.

ddx.vs: In NLPHL, CD20 highlights nodules of small background B cells with CD21+ FDC meshworks, and PD-1+ T cells rosette the LP cells.
HRS cells are CD30+ and CD15+ with CD20 negative or weak and heterogeneous, unlike uniformly CD20+ large B cells.
In PTCL the atypical intermediate-to-large cells themselves are CD3+ and CD20-, often with aberrant loss of pan-T antigens.
